title: .jgates/architecture.yml
description: The architecture the user wants, as an explicit contract: layers (or modules) with selectors and rules. Three families of rule: dependency (forbidden-dependency, component-boundary), cycles (no-cycles) and fan-in/fan-out (fan-limit). Never inferred. References between rules and layers are checked by the loader.

layers.description: Layers or modules. A node belongs to a layer when its path matches one of `paths` or its identity matches one of `modules`.

component.description: Restricts the layer to the nodes of one workspace component.

paths.description: Globs relative to the workspace (** crosses folders).

modules.description: Module names or globs matched against the node identity (for example shop_api.domain.*).

owner.description: source: the user keeps the rule; generated: the native configuration is produced from it.

from.description: forbidden-dependency: the layer that must not depend on the targets.

to.description: forbidden-dependency: the layers it must not depend on.

component.description: component-boundary: the workspace component the boundary protects.

allowedDependencies.description: component-boundary: the only other components it may depend on.

within.description: no-cycles: restricts the check to the nodes of one layer.

layer.description: fan-limit: restricts the limit to the nodes of one layer.
